instructions.grievance_bullet1: Check your latest Complain / Grievance / SRN / EID number status
instructions.dob_without_cert_title: DOB update without Birth Certificate is possible ONLY IF:
instructions.dob_without_cert_b1: If you are above 18 years of age
instructions.dob_without_cert_b2: And updating DOB for the first time
instructions.dob_without_cert_b3: Birth certificate was never used in previous Aadhaar enrolment/update
instructions.dob_without_cert_b4: If Passport, Service Card, PPO, or Marksheet was used previously, first time DOB update can be done with that document
instructions.dob_cert_required_title: Birth Certificate will be MANDATORY IF:
instructions.dob_cert_required_b1: If your age is below 18 years
instructions.dob_cert_required_b2: You are above 18 years and have updated DOB once before
instructions.dob_cert_required_b3: If previous enrolment/update was done with Birth Certificate, BRN on revised Birth Certificate must match
instructions.dob_cert_required_b4: If Passport, Service Card, PPO, or Marksheet was not used during previous enrolment/update
instructions.dob_table_row1_sit: Operator typing error (applicable only in data entry error cases)
instructions.dob_table_row1_doc: Same document used previously + Annexure‑2 (18+) / Annexure‑2(A) (<18)
instructions.dob_table_row2_doc: Must be converted to QR‑Code Birth Certificate verified on https://dc.crsorgi.gov.in/crs/
instructions.name_rule1: Minor name change in Aadhaar can be done only twice in a lifetime
instructions.name_marriage_note: (Marriage certificate with photo required for surname change after marriage)
instructions.name_full_change_text: For full name change, Gazette Notification is MANDATORY.
instructions.ask_info_text: For Aadhaar Seva Kendra details and official information provided by UIDAI, please visit the official Government of India page below:
instructions.index_consent: I confirm that I have read and understood all guidelines/instructions and have undertaken the required actions before proceeding further. I hereby voluntarily consent for collecting, processing, using my personal information with UIDAI
instructions.dob_sop_click: Click Here (Fill Annexure according to your situation on page number 8-13)
instructions.dob_step1: After receiving SMS that DOB request is under process, send EID/SID through email to help@uidai.gov.in
instructions.dob_step2: Write 28 digit enrolment ID (EID/SID) after office name DOB update in email subject
instructions.dob_step3: For EID check enrolment slip: Write enrolment number (14 digits) example: 1234/56789/48261
instructions.dob_step4: Write the date mentioned in slip in reverse order (year, month, day) and write time without ':'
instructions.dob_step5: Combine all details to create 28 digit EID
instructions.reactivation_intro: If Aadhaar became inactive due to previous DOB modification attempt using fake documents and you received the following message:
instructions.reactivation_sms: Dear Resident, the enrolment with UID XXXX XXXX XXXX has been suspended. You will need to update your biometrics. Please contact 1947 for any further query.
instructions.reactivation_upload_text: Visit Aadhaar Seva Kendra and complete biometric update (face, iris and fingerprints) with QR verified digital birth certificate and mandatory affidavit (Annexure-III/IIIA).
instructions.reactivation_step1: After receiving Aadhaar inactive SMS, send EID/SID through email to help@uidai.gov.in
instructions.reactivation_step2: Write 28 digit enrolment ID after office name Aadhaar Reactivation in email subject
instructions.reactivation_step3: Check EID from enrolment slip example: 1234/56789/48261
instructions.reactivation_step4: Write date in reverse order (year, month, day) and time without ':'
instructions.reactivation_step5: Combine all details to create 28 digit EID
instructions.name_step1: After receiving SMS, send EID/SID to help@uidai.gov.in
instructions.name_step2: Write office name followed by Name update in email subject
instructions.name_step3: Check EID (14 digits) from enrolment slip example: 1234/56789/48261
instructions.name_step4: Write date in reverse order (year, month, day) and time without ':'
